products.name: Altered
products.note: Professional voice editing; voice morphing; dubbing; consent management; UK-hosted

profile_text.body:
Altered is a UK-hosted voice AI company whose platform, Altered Studio, is described on its site as a voice content creation platform built for media production. The company offers speech-to-speech voice morphing, a voice editor for working inside existing audio and video files, and a real-time product called RealTime Pro, which is designed for use during voice and video calls. The site describes the platform as combining traditional DSP effects with AI tools and offering access to a curated set of AI voices intended to produce natural-sounding narration and voice performances.

The held facts note that Altered's single tracked product covers voice and audio use cases including professional voice editing, voice morphing, dubbing, and consent management, all hosted in the UK. No litigation, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent records are on file for the company.
